assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: definitive six-character roster art study for an original mobile 3v3 basketball league. Make a clean wide 3:2 image, pale cream studio floor and background, exactly six full-body athletes in a single spacious row, all feet visible, no overlap and no labels except jersey numbers. These are stylized simplified 3D animal athletes, with angular graphic faces, exaggerated athletic proportions, about 4 heads tall but adult demeanor. Strong sculpted masses, readable limbs and hands, flat smooth matte surfaces, crisp simple color blocking, 3-tone cel light. NO photorealism, NO fur strands, NO scales, NO fabric texture, NO cute huge heads. No resemblance to any existing animated character.
Order left to right:
1 Latch: tall slender grey hare with long ears angled backwards, patient raised eyebrow, rust-orange basketball jersey and shorts with cream trim and large number 7, ball tucked by hip.
2 Brunt: broad black-and-cream badger, square forearms, short powerful legs, stern face, rust-orange basketball kit with cream number 44, wide planted stance.
3 Zip: compact cream stoat with short rounded ears, narrow lively eyes, strong springy legs, rust-orange kit with number 11, hands held ready to catch.
4 Nix: lean burnt-orange fox with angular ears and short restrained tail, slightly mischievous focus, deep teal basketball jersey/shorts with cream number 4, low defensive stance.
5 Toll: heavy grey boar with broad chest, very short blunt tusks, upright still posture, teal kit with cream number 33.
6 Sable: tall lean tawny lynx with angular black cheek tufts and long arms, measured expression, teal kit with cream number 21, arm calmly held in a defensive posture.
Shared basic two-arm two-leg biped system, expressive three-finger hands, high-top sneakers, no gloves, no giant appendages. Team identity is clear orange versus teal; numbers readable. Exactly one basketball in entire plate. Make silhouettes varied and personalities evident through posture, while anatomy and materials belong to one coherent animated sports world. High-end graphic sports animation concept, playful physical presence and grown-up competitive attitude, not mascot suits or realistic furry humans. At thumbnail size the six players should remain separable. Neutral studio light with clear grounding shadows, no arena, no text or graphics in background.
assets.review: reviewed as visual concept; not production-ready

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: broadcast composition artwork for a proposed original mobile 3v3 basketball league. Use supplied image as the EXACT six-athlete identity and graphic low-poly art direction reference. These are the six existing competitors, not extra new characters. A basketball half-court with ONE hoop at the far end. An intimate brick municipal hall, cream plaster above brick, timber beams, broad diffuse overhead lighting, a bright pale-maple court, rust-colored key, crisp charcoal basketball lines and one three-point arc; shallow rows of small subdued spectators only beyond court boundary, visually secondary. No neon, no bloom, no arena darkness, no photoreal textures.
Exactly six athletes on the playing surface and exactly one orange basketball. Three rust uniforms: grey hare Latch #7 dribbling near the top of the arc in the foreground, broad badger Brunt #44 planting a screen to his left, compact cream stoat Zip #11 spaced on the right wing. Three teal uniforms: orange fox Nix #4 guarding Latch, grey boar Toll #33 protecting the lane below the hoop, lean tawny lynx Sable #21 marking Zip between wing and basket. Spread all six players so none overlap in the image. Their bodies, uniforms, numbers, heads, proportions, hands and sneakers must match the reference. Poses show basketball intent and grounded weight. Bright orange ball clearly visible below Latch's dribbling hand. Realistically coherent simple basketball half-court geometry, hoop over backboard marked basket, no second hoop or wrong-facing hoop.
The goal is readable gameplay composition: preserve all six athletes, the full key, rim, corners and arc. Moderate elevated broadcast angle, not top-down flat map, not dramatic floor-level action shot. Clean graphic game-engine rendering, smooth planar forms and restrained cel shading. This is a still concept of live action, not a poster. NO HUD, NO scoreboard, NO frame, NO phone bezel, NO logos, NO title, NO text or subtitles other than jersey numbers. Output PORTRAIT 2:3. Camera centered beyond the top of the half-court looking toward the basket high in the image. Frame the entire relevant court compactly so the six full-body players remain reasonably large and the basketball remains legible. Use the vertical screen efficiently: little ceiling, modest crowd strip at top, court fills almost all the image. Leave a little edge clearance for players' feet. Avoid huge empty foreground.
assets.review: six athletes and one ball visible; static composition concept only
